name: Electric Wire & Cable Specialists (EWCS)
old_description: If you're looking for immediate shipment of the wire and cable that you need, you've come to the right place with Electric Wire and Cable Specialists. We've been in business since 1994 and it's our goal to get your products delivered in two to five business days, no matter how far away from our multiple fulfillment centers you are.
about:
Electric Wire & Cable Specialists (EWCS) has operated from Phoenix, Arizona since 1994. The company was founded as a wholesale electrical supply business focused on rapid order fulfillment.

EWCS stocks and distributes a broad range of wire and cable products including copper building wire (THHN, TFFN), welding cable (600‑volt extra‑flexible), portable cord (SOOW, SJOOW), marine‑grade UL‑approved primary wire and battery cable, security and alarm cable, fire‑alarm cable, solar‑panel cable, and Belden‑style electronic cable. The company maintains seven fulfillment centers across the United States and offers cut‑to‑length service for most items. Orders typically ship within 24 hours on business days, with free surface shipping and a stated delivery window of two to five business days. International shipments reach destinations in Mexico, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, India, and Siberia.

The supplier serves contractors and installers in construction, electrical, marine, welding, security, solar, and industrial automation markets. Typical customers include electrical contractors pulling building wire, marine technicians needing UL‑approved battery cable, welders requiring flexible 600‑volt cable, and security integrators sourcing plenum‑rated access‑control cable.

EWCS emphasizes speed and flexibility as its core differentiators: same‑day shipping from multiple service centers, no‑minimum cut lengths, free ground freight, and the ability to handle both small and large special orders. The company’s stated goal is to deliver the exact cable a project needs within a week of ordering.
